scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @taskline/api" "npm run dev -w @taskline/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @taskline/shared && npm run build -w @taskline/api && npm run build -w @taskline/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @taskline/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
